name: Fisk Jubilee Singers’ fundraising tour
description: Fisk students toured to support their school and brought African American spirituals to new concert audiences.

impact.note: One tour that carried spirituals to concert audiences in America and Europe; a clear widening of an existing music, with concert-spiritual successors.

date.label: 6 October 1871
date.basis: Fisk’s archives dates the beginning of the concert tour to 6 October 1871.

events.statement: A group of Fisk students began a fundraising concert tour.
events.scope: Departure for the tour; their repertoire changed during the tour.

evidence.supports: A group of Fisk students began a fundraising concert tour.

contributions.resource: Performed on a fundraising tour for the school.

evidence.supports: Fisk identifies the students and their tour.

contributions.resource: Organized the group and borrowed funds for the tour.

evidence.supports: The finding aid says White organized the tour and borrowed money.

date.label: By May 1872
date.basis: Smithsonian states the sum had been raised by May 1872, an upper bound rather than a date on which the sum was reached.

events.statement: The singers had raised $20,000 in support of Fisk by May 1872.
events.scope: A historical nominal-dollar amount reported by the museum; not a complete lifetime tour total.

evidence.supports: The singers had raised $20,000 in support of Fisk by May 1872.

earliest_record.rationale: Date and scope follow the cited event; this is the earliest episode established in this research, not a claim of world priority.

caveats: Spirituals were created and transmitted by African American communities before this tour, often under enslavement. The ensemble did not originate the tradition, and sources describe repertoire changes after the tour began. The financial amount is a retrospective museum claim.

research.note: Independent second reader checked the cited historical episodes, dates and actor roles against the stated source passages, subject to the caveats; other facets are not blanket reviewed.

measures.conditions: By May 1872 according to the Smithsonian portrait label; nominal historical dollars, not adjusted for inflation.
measures.subject: Funds raised by the Fisk student singers for Fisk by May 1872
